files.description: Shipments (400 rows): shipment_id (whole number), ordered_on and shipped_on (dates as text, YYYY-MM-DD, in 2025; shipped_on is empty for about 4% of rows that have not shipped yet), carrier (DHL, UPS, PostNord or GLS; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), weight_kg (one decimal), value (order value, two decimals).

task_text: Total the order value per calendar month of ordered_on. Label each month by the moment at which the month ends (its last instant), not by its first day. `result` should be a Series indexed by that month-end moment with the summed value, in time order.
intended_computation: Group the 400 shipments by the month of ordered_on (12 months of 2025), sum value per month and index each sum by the last instant of its month (e.g. 2025-01-31 23:59:59.999...), ascending.

acceptable_variants.notes: the last instant may be given to the second, millisecond, microsecond or nanosecond.

predicted_direction.reason: the month end moves from the last nanosecond to the last microsecond; both mark the end of the month

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
